name: ICS Arabia Desert Dragon Data Center Phase 1 (Al Kharj)
developer: ICS Arabia (Desert Dragon, with China Mobile International and Lumaotong Group)
notes: Phase 1 of the 187 MW national Desert Dragon program is a 64-65 MW Tier III data center located in Al Kharj Industrial City (MODON), Riyadh region, per Blackridge Research and the project engineer's public profile; construction started November 2024 with first phase expected operational around March 2026. Baxtel lists the facility (year built 2026) as ICS Arabia Riyadh / Desert Dragon project. Later phases are in Jeddah, Dammam and NEOM (outside this division).

name: AWS Saudi Arabia infrastructure region (Riyadh)
notes: AWS announced in March 2024 a new infrastructure region in Saudi Arabia with an investment of more than USD 5.3 billion, located in Riyadh and scheduled to launch in 2026. Blackridge (Oct 2025 status) reports final phase of construction with go-live in 2026; multiple availability zones with services including EC2, S3, SageMaker. No public MW capacity disclosed.

name: AWS & HUMAIN AI Zone (Riyadh)
notes: Official AWS/Amazon announcement (May 2025): AWS and HUMAIN plan to invest more than USD 5 billion to build an AI Zone in Saudi Arabia, located in Riyadh. Expanded partnership to deploy up to 150,000 AI accelerators (NVIDIA GB300 plus AWS Trainium) in the AI Zone data center in Riyadh. Capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Oracle Cloud Riyadh region
notes: Oracle launched its second public cloud region in Saudi Arabia in Riyadh (August 2024) as part of a USD 1.5 billion investment, hosted by center3; region joins Oracle Cloud Jeddah and a planned NEOM region. Announced Feb 2023. No public MW capacity.

name: Huawei Cloud Riyadh region data center
notes: Huawei Cloud Riyadh Region opened 4 September 2023 (Huawei's 30th worldwide data center) with a 3-availability-zone architecture; stores data in Saudi Arabia per local data regulations and serves Middle East, Central Asia and Africa. No public MW capacity.

name: center3 Khurais data center (Riyadh)
notes: center3 completed a 9.6 MW expansion of its hyperscaler-grade Khurais data center in Riyadh (reported 2024); Baxtel lists the facility as Center3 Khurais RDC301 (built 2019). center3 operates 25+ data centers across Saudi Arabia and is expanding its portfolio toward 300+ MW (1 GW by 2030 per Total Telecom). Expansion MW noted; total facility power not fully public.

name: STC AlRaidah Digital City Tier IV data center (Riyadh)
notes: STC opened a Tier IV (Uptime Institute) data center at AlRaidah Digital City in Riyadh in 2018, reported at the time as giving STC the largest data center capacity in the country. No public MW capacity.

name: QST 300 MW MCIT data center program - Riyadh facilities
notes: QST signed an agreement with the Saudi Ministry of Communications and Information Technology to develop 300 MW of data center capacity (six 50 MW facilities) across Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah and NEOM by 2026; QST's Riyadh data centres are live/under construction (QST Data Centre 1 per CST list) and MEED reports construction advanced on the first phase. Capacity figure is the whole national program, not a single Riyadh building.

name: Khazna Riyadh data center (first Saudi facility)
notes: Khazna (G42/Mubadala JV) announced entry into Saudi Arabia with a first data center in Riyadh of 20 MW initial capacity (Dec 2025, per AGBI/MENA Startup Digest), first phase of a planned hyperscale network. Note: some December 2025 coverage describes Khazna's first Saudi campus as a 225,000 sqm 200 MW land purchase in Dammam (Eastern Province), so the Riyadh facility status is flagged as uncertain; no ground-breaking confirmed.

name: Edgnex (DAMAC Digital) Riyadh data center campus (RUH-1)
notes: Baxtel lists the Edgnex Riyadh Campus (20 MW) as the largest data center in Riyadh (18 facilities, 10 operators per Baxtel market facts); DataCenterMap lists Edgnex Riyadh RUH-1 within 30 km of Riyadh center; Dosan Energy supplied cooling for the DAMAC EDGNEX Riyadh facility. Capacity from aggregate directory sources; exact site not public.

name: Sahayeb Data Park Riyadh (DC1/DC2)
notes: Sahayeb operates a Riyadh data park (Riyadh DC1 and flagship Riyadh DC2) with 24 MW initial combined IT capacity expandable to 120 MW; several phases under construction with new capacity online late 2025 into early 2026, part of a Riyadh/Dammam national network. Capacity is initial combined figure.

name: DataVolt MODON AI-ready data center (Riyadh First Technology Park)
notes: DataVolt signed a February 2025 land lease with MODON (Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities) for a 55,000 sqm AI-ready data center in the First Technology Park, eastern Riyadh; planning/development phase under DataVolt's broader USD 5 billion KSA program. DataCenterMap separately lists 'DataVolt Riyadh East DC' (Khurais 522 St) as under construction with 16 MW phase 1 IT load targeted live Q1 2027; relationship between the two listings is not fully confirmed.

name: HUMAIN & AirTrunk Riyadh data center campus
notes: HUMAIN and AirTrunk (Blackstone-backed) formalized a partnership in October 2025 to build a large-scale data center campus in Riyadh with an initial investment of about USD 3 billion - AirTrunk's first Middle East expansion; pre-development phase. MW capacity not yet disclosed.

name: Saudi Cloud Computing Company (SCCC) / Alibaba Cloud Riyadh data centers
developer: SCCC (stc Group, Alibaba Cloud, eWTP Arabia Capital, SCAI, SITE)
notes: Saudi Cloud Computing Company, the stc Group-Alibaba Cloud joint venture, launched cloud services from two data centers in Riyadh (announced 2022); Defense One (May 2025) confirms the twin availability-zone data centers in Riyadh serve government ministries, financial institutions and retailers. No public MW capacity.

name: Mobily Khurais data center (Riyadh)
notes: Mobily operates a Uptime Tier III certified data center at An Nasim Ash Sharqi on Khurais Road, Riyadh (DataCenterMap; CST licensed-provider list references 'Mobily - Khurais DC'); a separate Mobily data center project on Khurais Road is documented by engineering firm Alekhtiar. No public MW capacity.

name: Zain KSA Riyadh data center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Zain KSA Riyadh (5.6 MW) as a next-generation hyperscale facility developed in collaboration with Ericsson and designed by Azura Consultancy. Capacity from aggregate directory listing; no operator disclosure found.

name: Ezditek RUH01 data center (Princess Nourah University, Riyadh)
notes: Ezditek broke ground in November 2024 on its flagship RUH01 data center on a 35,000 sqm plot inside Princess Nourah Bint Abdulrahman University, Riyadh; 24 MW maximum capacity, expected go-live Q1 2026; flagship of a 170 MW Ezditek program (Jeddah, Dammam and other Riyadh sites).

name: Salam (ITC) Riyadh cloud data centers
notes: The Saudi Communications, Space & Technology Commission (CST) licensed-provider list records Salam/ITC operating 'ITC Riyadh Cloud Data Center' and 'Salam Riyadh Narjis Data Center' in Riyadh. Official regulator listing; no public capacity.
